publisher: Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia (INGV)
extraction: Native 10m-aligned WCS window, nearest-neighbour request at source resolution. Bilinear pixel-centre UTM sampling onto a 257x257 geographic grid; south-to-north output rows, rounded to millimetres. No smoothing, fill, slope clipping, vertical exaggeration, offset fitted to visibility, or data fabricated from images. Output oversamples one horizontal axis; native resolution remains 10m.
limitations: Regional bare-earth DEM, compilation released 2023 with mixed older regional sources. Not a 2026 engineering survey; local vertical datum/earthworks, bridge decks, spectator terraces and fence bases not certified. Smaller pixels alone do not prove better local accuracy.
